state: Actual short-summary and long-cache selectors; no new graph entities or language approval

records.name: Intention-to-treat (ITT) and per-protocol analysis (simple)
records.text: Count people in the group they were assigned to, even if treatment changed. Missing results still need careful handling.

records.name: Endpoint (simple)
records.text: An endpoint says what the study measures and when. The plan states what result would count as success.

records.name: Trial protocol and statistical analysis plan (simple)
records.text: The trial protocol is the rulebook a trial is run by, written before it starts, and the statistical analysis plan fixes how the answer will be calculated.

records.name: Objective response rate (ORR) (simple)
records.text: The share of people who meet the study rules for complete or partial tumour response.

records.name: Case report (simple)
records.text: A report of what happened to one person can raise useful questions. It usually cannot separate the treatment effect from other possible explanations.

records.text: How much follow-up and outcome information a result has. An unreached median alone does not tell you whether the treatment comparison is precise.

records.name: KEYNOTE-522 (simple)
records.text: This trial tested adding pembrolizumab before and after surgery to the same chemotherapy plan. It measured response and survival.

records.name: OptimICE-pCR (A012103) (simple)
records.text: This trial asks whether people with no invasive cancer left at surgery can omit the next 27 weeks of pembrolizumab.

records.name: Randomised trial (simple)
records.text: Chance assigns people to different treatment groups. This helps make a fair comparison, but does not guarantee identical groups or complete follow-up.

records.text: Kaplan-Meier 曲线显示在每个时间点仍然存活（或仍未进展）的患者比例；每发生一次事件曲线就下降一个台阶，并利用所有人的随访时间，即使他们尚未发生事件。

records.name: Kaplan-Meier curve, censoring and proportional hazards (simple)
records.text: A Kaplan-Meier curve shows the share of patients still alive or free of progression at each point in time, stepping down each time an event happens.

records.text: 相对获益说风险下降了三分之一；绝对获益说每 100 人中实际有多少人免于不良结局，这取决于该事件原本有多常见，也是判断治疗是否值得其副作用的关键数字。

records.name: Absolute versus relative benefit (number needed to treat) (simple)
records.text: A relative benefit says the risk fell by a third, while an absolute benefit says how many people out of 100 were actually spared, which is the number that matters when weighing side effects.

records.name: Subgroup analysis (forest plots) (simple)
records.text: A treatment can be studied in groups defined by age, a marker or another feature. Different-looking results do not by themselves prove different treatment effects.

records.name: Meta-analysis (simple)
records.text: A calculation that combines results from suitable studies. A precise average can still hide different results, bias or incompatible questions.
